attempt.snapshot: immutable published definition revision + immutable selected question set; never replace questions during resume

task.language: German content, UI labels outside DTO translated by S4

proof.scope: auth.uid + exact text version + test version only; no expiry absent changed version; commercial authorization checked independently every request

rules: Every essential actually present competency sampled at least 3 times; require ceiling(2*n/3) for EACH plus ceiling(0.75*total) overall
One item assesses exactly one declared primary competency; no double counting
Core vocabulary/inflection/syntax plus other actually necessary competencies are authored per text with source evidence; omit absent categories explicitly with reason
Six or more authored non-equivalent pool items per core allow two disjoint balanced forms; no title-only templates
No score, readiness, learning evidence, word/verb minimum, text length or historical override outside this test determines pass
No delayed retake gate; failed attempts retained, next start creates new balanced form; one active current-version attempt per account/text

version_policy: Content version hashes exact stored German body; definition version hashes immutable matrix/pool/criteria/keys
New active text or definition requires current-version test proof; old attempt becomes outdated, remains accessible to owner/staff

No compatibility transfer is required initially: new text/test version requires a new individual test, retaining all old results. Transfer stays disabled until an explicit validated compatibility implementation exists; no hard/checkpoint/VIP migration.
Definition missing/invalid closes new starts; staff diagnostics actionable; inactive drafts may save without publication
Compatibility is optional: initial implementation may invalidate on any material current-version change and retain old results, without pass transfer.
schema: sitov_pronunciation_private.pretest_definitions (immutable private matrix, pool, keys, policy, audio authoring proof)
sitov_pronunciation_private.pretest_attempts (account ownership, selected task IDs, frozen versions, CAS revision, terminal result)
sitov_pronunciation_private.upload_tickets (account, exact prompt/version, owned immutable path, expiry/consumption)
atomicity: Advisory xact lock account/text; partial unique current open attempt; row lock/CAS answers+submit
Repeat exact request payload returns persisted receipt; reused key with different payload rejects
Complete answers only selected IDs and allowed option IDs; no extra keys, caller score, account or substituted text
Pass creation and attempt terminal result same transaction; concurrent submit sees same canonical result
Private tables RLS enabled, zero direct authenticated DML/key reads; invoker public wrappers to checked narrow private functions, search_path empty, explicit EXECUTE grants
publication: Validated text-specific matrix/pool/criteria and immutable text/version association required for every active target
Written pretest has no audio player; content authoring review required; no unused new audio synthesis
Existing pronunciation reference must have valid prepared Qwen/timing/import proof; any actually new audible task needs M local Qwen and imported storage proof before publication
Direct DB/RPC publication enforces complete definition and required actual audio proof; incomplete items remain inactive drafts
shared_blockers: Privatize/reference-authorize audio_cache; current getPublicUrl plus arbitrary de generateAudio leaks target reference
S1 commercial unit/item authorization contract incl language-neutral access
S2 precise validated accessible mapping targets
M full normalized current-schema fixture through 92 plus 93 access before 94, no stale 01-58-only acceptance
